procedures.title: Authority, Environments, Roles, and Operational Governance

steps.name: Pre-authorize
steps.action: Confirm ticket, risk class, acting identity, authority, separation of duties, current certification, approved window, target, and rollback/containment.

steps.name: Baseline
steps.action: Capture health, state versions, queues, capacity, active transactions, Treaties, alerts, evidence integrity, and human-visible conditions.

steps.name: Validate inputs
steps.action: Verify signed artifacts/configuration, Book IX compatibility, dependencies, credentials by reference, privacy classification, and expected state.

steps.name: Establish safety
steps.action: Enable observation, freeze conflicting work, bound blast radius, assign commander and verifier, and announce stop conditions.

steps.name: Execute
steps.action: Perform the approved action one checkpoint at a time; record operator, timestamp, command or contract, target, result, and evidence digest.

steps.name: Observe
steps.action: Compare health, outcomes, invariants, authority decisions, privacy signals, queue behavior, and resource use to approved thresholds.

steps.name: Decide
steps.action: Continue only when success criteria pass and no stop condition fires; otherwise halt, contain, roll back, or enter forward recovery.

steps.name: Reconcile
steps.action: Resolve state, messages, external effects, in-flight transactions, evidence gaps, and temporary access; do not guess ambiguous reality.

steps.name: Verify
steps.action: Run targeted Book VIII verification, contract tests, recovery checks, and independent review appropriate to risk.

steps.name: Close
steps.action: Record final state, limitations, certificate impact, follow-up actions, approvers, evidence manifest, and communication; revoke temporary authority.
